cohort: 440,119 live infants born at 259-293 days of gestation in São Paulo, Brazil, between 2012-2017
finding: Neonatal mortality was higher for infants born early term, decreasing in infants born full term and rising again in infants born late term.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were associated with a decrease in gestational age at birth and an increase in neonatal mortality.
